body.name: Four-cell posterior quotient ledger
body.construction: Order the cells as \(\sigma_1=(-,-)\), \(\sigma_2=(-,+)\), \(\sigma_3=(+,-)\), and \(\sigma_4=(+,+)\). For each residue, fixed chart, and observation face, define \(D^{(k)}=\sum_{j=1}^kD_{\sigma_j,r,x^{\mathrm{obs}}}\), \(N^{(k)}=\sum_{j=1}^kN_{\sigma_j,r,x^{\mathrm{obs}}}\), and \(S^{(k)}=(N^{(k)})^2/D^{(k)}\), with an exact zero-denominator face omitted and \(S^{(0)}=0\). Apply the finite-lattice coefficient-array valuation and quotient recurrence to each sequence difference \(S^{(k)}-S^{(k-1)}\). The sum of the four resulting degree-eight arrays is the degree-eight array of the single posterior quotient \(N_{r,x}^2/D_{r,x}\); the cells form an additive telescoping ledger and are never normalized as four separate posteriors.
